title: HelperSSHConnectionStateEvent
description: One observation of an ssh connection, sent to the coordinator that opened the pane riding it (nocx-oalo1.5.3). It is a NOTIFICATION because a connection's state is revised for as long as the connection exists, in both directions, and there is no request to answer. `seq` orders observations of one connection, which is how a receiver refuses one that arrives after a newer one. The helper names exactly the fields its state makes true: a stage only while opening, a person only while waiting, a cause only when failed or ended, an attempt only while reconnecting. The coordinator's own `pane.connection` schema is the stricter half (one branch per state); this shape stays flat because a frozen generation is fenced on the FIELDS, not on the combination.

connectionId.description: The supervisor's connection, the same value the `connection` op answered for the destination.

seq.description: Monotonic per connection for the life of the supervisor. A receiver drops anything not greater than the last sequence it applied; that is how a late observation of an older moment is refused.

state.description: The transport state, in hostconn.Kind's own spellings: opening, waiting_person, connected, stalled, reconnecting, failed, ended. `plain` is NOT here: it names a system ssh process, which is a carrier this helper is not, and a state a producer cannot reach must not be a value its wire admits.

stage.description: Where an opening is: resolve, tcp, ssh-version, key-exchange, sign-in, shell. Present exactly when state is opening.

person.description: What a waiting_person state waits for. Present exactly when state is waiting_person. `key-signature` is an unanswered agent sign call, which cannot be told from a slow agent, so its text says a touch may be needed.

cause.description: Why a failed or ended connection stopped. Present exactly for those two states. `silence` never appears on a failure that ended a plain shell: design §5.3 makes that the person's choice.

attempt.description: How many attempts a reconnecting connection has made since it last worked. Present exactly when state is reconnecting.

stateMs.description: How long the connection has been in this state, at the observation, in milliseconds. The renderer ticks it locally from here, so a quiet connection costs no frames. Always present, including on a still-silent stalled connection whose measurement grew.

lookAnsweredAt.description: When a look-only dial was answered during the current stall, RFC3339 in UTC. It says the HOST accepts new connections while this flow is silent — evidence a person is shown, never a verdict on the flow. Present only while stalled, and only once a look has answered.

plainShells.description: How many shells would end if this connection closed: its own, and those of everything dialed through it. It is what makes 'Reconnect ends 2 shells' sayable, and it is why silence never closes a connection carrying one. Present for connected and stalled.

roundTripMs.description: The newest probe's measurement, in milliseconds. Absent until a probe has answered; absent and zero are the same statement — nothing measured — and a reader must treat them alike.

slow.description: Whether the backend GRADES that measurement slow. It is sent rather than left to a reader to threshold, because the grade has hysteresis and a reader holding only the milliseconds cannot reproduce it.
